title: Xiaomi MiTV-MSSP1 (codename nino), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.5925 release-keys.
header:
Xiaomi MiTV-MSSP1 (codename nino), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.5925 release-keys.

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-mssp1/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-mssp1/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. It is not listed here;
launcher/build-and-install.sh handles its cutover after the replacement Home is installed.
Live TV: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter; HDMI/tuner service: com.mediatek.tvinput. Both kept enabled.
Also kept enabled: com.xiaomi.mitv.updateservice (firmware updates), Google Assistant,
Chromecast, com.xiaomi.mitv.mediaexplorer (USB media), Play Store and Play Services.

Checks on this set: the replacement Home survived reboot; the owner confirmed streaming-app
playback. All eight packages below remain disabled.
No package from this list had to be re-enabled during those checks.
This is nino / PI.5925, not the MSSP0 (amelie), MSSP2 (volver) or MSSP3 (machuca) firmware.
